evidence.quote: There are no changes to the pricing for data transferred over VPC Peering connections.
Previously, VPC Peering usage was reported under the intra-regional Data Transfer usage, making it difficult for customers to understand their VPC Peering usage and charges.
Starting today, we are making it easier for customers to understand their inter-availability zone (AZ) VPC Peering usage within the same AWS Region by introducing a new usage type in their bill.

evidence.heading: AWS simplifies Amazon VPC Peering billing
